question: How many trips were there in total?
What is the total fare collected across all days?
Which date had the most trips?
reference_sql: SELECT pickup_date FROM gold_daily_summary ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which date had the fewest trips?
reference_sql: SELECT pickup_date FROM gold_daily_summary ORDER BY trips ASC LIMIT 1

question: How many distinct days are in the data?
Which pickup zip had the most trips overall?
reference_sql: SELECT pickup_zip FROM gold_daily_zone_stats GROUP BY pickup_zip ORDER BY SUM(trips) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 3 pickup zips by total fare?
reference_sql: SELECT pickup_zip FROM gold_daily_zone_stats GROUP BY pickup_zip ORDER BY SUM(total_fare) DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many distinct pickup zips are there?
What was the maximum number of active pickup zips on any single day?
Which pickup zip has the highest average trip distance, counting only zips with at least 50 trips in total?
reference_sql: SELECT pickup_zip FROM gold_daily_zone_stats GROUP BY pickup_zip HAVING SUM(trips) >= 50 ORDER BY SUM(avg_distance * trips) / SUM(trips) DESC LIMIT 1

question: On which date was the average fare highest?
reference_sql: SELECT pickup_date FROM gold_daily_summary ORDER BY avg_fare DESC LIMIT 1
